evals.prompt: Build a reusable remoteStorage.js data module for bookmarks with add/list/get/remove and a share(id) method that publishes a bookmark publicly and returns its public URL. Then show how an app registers and uses it. Plain JavaScript, ES modules.

assertions.name: a1
assertions.description: Declares a JSON Schema type with declareType before any storeObject call (storeObject throws SchemaNotFound without one)
assertions.check: Declares a JSON Schema type with declareType before any storeObject call (storeObject throws SchemaNotFound without one)

assertions.name: a2
assertions.description: list() reads the module root with getAll() or getAll('') — NOT getAll('/'), which returns an empty object on a module client
assertions.check: list() reads the module root with getAll() or getAll('') — NOT getAll('/'), which returns an empty object on a module client

assertions.name: a3
assertions.description: share() writes via publicClient and awaits getItemURL (treated as a Promise), not as a synchronous string return
assertions.check: share() writes via publicClient and awaits getItemURL (treated as a Promise), not as a synchronous string return

assertions.name: a4
assertions.description: Module uses the { name, builder(privateClient, publicClient) } shape returning { exports } and is registered with rs.addModule plus rs.access.claim
assertions.check: Module uses the { name, builder(privateClient, publicClient) } shape returning { exports } and is registered with rs.addModule plus rs.access.claim

assertions.name: a5
assertions.description: Mentions that getItemURL resolves undefined when not connected and/or does not work on Google Drive
assertions.check: Mentions that getItemURL resolves undefined when not connected and/or does not work on Google Drive

evals.prompt: I'm building a todo PWA with remotestoragejs. Write the data layer: setup, a 'todo' type, CRUD, and keep a UI list in sync when changes arrive from other devices, without rerendering the whole list on every item. I only care about remote and conflict changes.

assertions.name: a1
assertions.description: changeEvents in the constructor sets all four keys explicitly (local, window, remote, conflict), or the answer warns that a partial object disables the omitted origins
assertions.check: changeEvents in the constructor sets all four keys explicitly (local, window, remote, conflict), or the answer warns that a partial object disables the omitted origins

assertions.name: a2
assertions.description: Declares the 'todo' type with declareType before storeObject
assertions.check: Declares the 'todo' type with declareType before storeObject

assertions.name: a3
assertions.description: change handler applies each event incrementally (upsert/remove by relativePath) rather than calling getAll() inside the handler
assertions.check: change handler applies each event incrementally (upsert/remove by relativePath) rather than calling getAll() inside the handler

assertions.name: a4
assertions.description: If sync-done is used, its handler reads the { completed } payload and the instance identifier used (e.g. rs) is actually defined in the code
assertions.check: If sync-done is used, its handler reads the { completed } payload and the instance identifier used (e.g. rs) is actually defined in the code

assertions.name: a5
assertions.description: Enables caching for the claimed path and does not call startSync() after writes
assertions.check: Enables caching for the claimed path and does not call startSync() after writes

evals.prompt: My remoteStorage app should also let users connect Dropbox and Google Drive. Show me the setup code and tell me exactly what I need to configure in the Dropbox App Console and Google Cloud Console, and what doesn't work on those backends.

assertions.name: a1
assertions.description: Dropbox scope list includes sharing.read and sharing.write (and notes Dropbox rejects auth with invalid_scope without them)
assertions.check: Dropbox scope list includes sharing.read and sharing.write (and notes Dropbox rejects auth with invalid_scope without them)

assertions.name: a2
assertions.description: Does NOT claim getItemURL is unsupported on Dropbox; states Dropbox getItemURL returns a shared-link preview URL (dl=0 → raw=1 for raw content)
assertions.check: Does NOT claim getItemURL is unsupported on Dropbox; states Dropbox getItemURL returns a shared-link preview URL (dl=0 → raw=1 for raw content)

assertions.name: a3
assertions.description: States Google Drive does not support getItemURL / public sharing
assertions.check: States Google Drive does not support getItemURL / public sharing

assertions.name: a4
assertions.description: Describes Google verification as avoiding a security warning rather than as a hard requirement for production
assertions.check: Describes Google verification as avoiding a security warning rather than as a hard requirement for production

assertions.name: a5
assertions.description: Uses rs.setApiKeys({ dropbox, googledrive }) and mentions the 150 MB Dropbox file limit and case-insensitive paths
assertions.check: Uses rs.setApiKeys({ dropbox, googledrive }) and mentions the 150 MB Dropbox file limit and case-insensitive paths
